findings.title: No in-flight guard on status confirm
findings.problem: confirmStatusChange awaits deactivateUser/reactivateUser while the modal stays open and the confirm button stays enabled; setPendingStatusChange(null) runs only in finally. A quick double click sends duplicate DELETE/POST requests.
findings.impact: The second request fails and shows a spurious error toast after a successful change; duplicate side effects possible.
findings.recommendation: Add an isStatusChanging state; return early if set, set it before the await and clear it in finally; pass it as loading/disabled to the confirmation modal.

findings.title: Refresh may leave empty page after status change
findings.problem: After a successful status change refresh() reloads the current page with the active filters. With a status filter active, changing the only row on the last page leaves an empty table although earlier pages still match.
findings.impact: User sees an empty list and must navigate back manually. Reachability of the empty-last-page case is plausible but not exercised in code reviewed.
findings.recommendation: If the current page held one row and page > 0, load the previous page; otherwise refresh().
